name: Drawing Space
layout: A pocket world generated from open Inkwell focus and active drawings. Terrain reads as paper, ink washes, and sketched landforms rather than natural geology. Early visits are gentle ink hills; crisis visit becomes a storm of unfinished strokes and torn-paper sky. Space collapses when the Inkwell lid closes or focus breaks.
key_landmarks: Horizon line that can pale when ink thins
Arena-like clear ground for facing The Unfinished
furniture_objects: Occasional giant sketched props if drawn intentionally
Floating line fragments and eraser-dust motes as environmental particles
Platform-like paper sheets that act as ground planes
visual_identifiers: Line-art physics: hatching as grass, contour lines as ridges
Coloring-book clarity: large shapes, limited clutter
Mood shifts with story: playful → thinning → storm → cleared
Characters remain solid against sketchy environment
Effects stay ink/paper themed—not fire/ice elemental defaults
camera_possibilities: Wide establishing of fantastical paper landscape
Low angle on Unfinished in storm
continuity_constraints: Drawing space only appears while Inkwell rules allow (open, focused, ink available)
Visual state must match chapter emotion: play vs crisis vs calm
Do not treat as a permanent physical location on the neighbourhood map
When collapsing, return characters to the real location they entered from (bedroom or school vicinity per page plan)
Avoid redesigning as a generic video-game void unrelated to ink/paper
